latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Higgsfield Product Photoshoot skill.

- Provides a CLI tool to generate brand-quality product images using mode-specific prompt enhancements.
- Supports multiple generation modes, including studio, lifestyle, Pinterest pin, hero banner, carousel, ad packs, virtual try-on, conceptual, and restyle.
- Includes an interactive pre-generation interview with concise, labeled questions to refine outputs.
- Delivers only image URLs as output, with silent polling until results are ready.
- Not intended for unbranded text-to-image, marketing videos, or Soul Character training.
